job.email_subject: Application: React PWA & Commerce Cloud role – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I saw your post for React PWA and commerce cloud work – I bring 5+ years of headless commerce, including APIs built for PWA frontends at Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– RESTful APIs and OCC web services for PWA and headless storefronts
– Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript and storefront customization
– Third-party and PIM / ERP integrations on enterprise commerce

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Headless Commerce, PWA Integration & REST APIs | Java
tailoring.summary: E-commerce developer with 5+ years on enterprise headless commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, worked with JavaScript and storefront customization, and delivered third-party and PIM / ERP integrations. Strong in Java, Spring Boot and microservices, executes CI/CD deployment cycles, performs code reviews and works in agile, international teams with AI-assisted development.
tailoring.why_company: Your role sits exactly where my experience is strongest: the connection between a PWA storefront and a commerce backend. I have built APIs for PWA frontends at Shell and headless APIs at Rockwell Automation, and I want to apply that integration depth to a modern composable commerce project. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: React PWA & Commerce Cloud role
en.hook: Your post looks for a developer who can connect a PWA storefront to a commerce cloud backend. That bridge has been my work for years: at Shell I built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce integrations and PWA frontends, and at Rockwell Automation I expose headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers on SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: PWA storefront integration
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends at Shell.

bullets.label: Headless commerce APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services for storefront and third-party consumers and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Commerce cloud depth
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data, plus Promotions Engine and Order Management (OMS).

bullets.label: Delivery quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds, performed code reviews and used AI tools extensively to accelerate development and testing.
